default.notes: Visa-free entry for up to 30 days. SG Arrival Card required before travel.

groups.notes: Visa-free entry, normally granted 90 days. The exact stay is stamped at the ICA officer's discretion. SG Arrival Card required before travel.
Visa-free entry for up to 30 days under ASEAN arrangements. SG Arrival Card required before travel.
An entry visa is required, applied for online through a Singapore-authorised visa agent or a Singapore mission. SG Arrival Card also required before travel.

SG.notes: Singaporean citizens enter freely with a valid Singapore passport.

CN.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under the China–Singapore mutual visa exemption in force since 9 February 2024. SG Arrival Card required before travel.

KZ.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under the Singapore–Kazakhstan mutual visa exemption — confirm on ica.gov.sg before booking. SG Arrival Card required before travel.
